title: Prerequisite
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

TOU exception responses can only be archived if the respective billing document, whose billing period is found during the
period for the corresponding TOU exception, has been archived.

e Write temporary index:

The system writes the contract and the TOU exception program to the index table ETOUEXCEPTRESPAR for the TOU
exception responses that can be archived. This index table is used as the basis for archiving. Once data has been
successfully archived and deleted, the system deletes the respective index entry from the database.

2. Archiving of Selected TOU Exception Responses (Report REAARCH_ARCH_EXRESP)

Prerequisite

Before starting this archiving report, you must perform at least one analysis using the REAARCH_ANALYSE_EXRESP report.

Process Flow

The archiving report selects TOU exception responses for which a corresponding entry exists in the index table
ETOUEXCEPTRESPAR, whose entries are generated by the analysis report. The system writes the entries found to the archive.

1 Note

If you start the report in the test mode, the system does not write the data to the archive, and only displays an overview of the
documents you can archive (if a detailed log display is required).

When you start the report you can make various settings on the initial screen:

e Log type: General statistical data, detail log with detailed data for each analyzed record or detail log with detailed data for
documents that could not be archived.

e Test run: If you start the report as a test run, no data is written to the database.

e Comment on archive run: Here you can enter an individual comment for an archiving run.

In variant maintenance for the write program, the following actions from SAP NetWeaver Information Lifecycle Management are
available to you:

e Archiving

You can use this action to archive data for completed business objects. The system performs archivability checks to
establish whether data can be archived. In this regard, this function is the same as standard data archiving. The ILM
enhancements mean that during the write phase, the system can evaluate the rules maintained in the Information
Retention Manager (IRM) for each object instance and therefore determine the retention period and the storage location
for the object. This information is persisted to the database as part of the administration data and is interpreted later
during storage.

e Snapshots

Snapshots are archiving sessions that are used to extract data from the database. This data is not deleted from the
database. The system does not execute any additional checks other than checking the restrictions in the selection variant.
You can use this option to write data to the archive from current, open business transactions. To prevent data from being
lost, this type of session is not provided for data deletion. Therefore, snapshots always create redundant copies of data
from the database. The snapshot function is mainly intended for use in conjunction with the ILM Retention Warehouse
